sprint: Sprint 4 — Pilot Closure and Next Coverage Wave

per_type_constraints_defined.detail: slides.yml per_type_constraints defines Convert, Compress, and Merger. Convert: ToPdf static file-path overload. Compress: takes Presentation object + must call pres.Save() after. Merger: static Process() with string[] array.

template_hints_defined.detail: slides.yml template_hints has input_creation_lines (Presentation + AddEmptySlide + Save), merger_input_creation_lines (2 PPTX files), additional_usings, array_input_filenames, default_output_extension=.pptx.

fixture_strategy_documented.detail: workspace/verification/latest/slides-pilot-readiness-design.json. programmatic_pptx via Aspose.Slides.Presentation + AddEmptySlide. Compress in-place mutation + pres.Save() pattern. Pair fixture for Merger.
fixture_strategy_documented.convert_recommended_path: Convert.ToPdf(presPath, outputPath) — file-path static overload, simplest
fixture_strategy_documented.compress_critical_note: Compress mutates Presentation in-place — MUST call pres.Save() after Compress methods
fixture_strategy_documented.merger_pair_fixture: 2 PPTX files created programmatically: pres1.Save('input1.pptx'), pres2.Save('input2.pptx')

xml_docs_gap_assessment.issue: Package contains Aspose.Slides.xml but pipeline expects Aspose.Slides.NET.xml (DLL name mismatch)
xml_docs_gap_assessment.mitigation: DLL fallback implemented in extractor (endswith('.NET') strip). API catalog has method signatures from reflection. LLM prompts lack docstring context but method signatures sufficient.
xml_docs_gap_assessment.action_required: None — accept xml_warning, proceed with reflection-only catalog

Convert.pattern: Static file-path overload — no Presentation object required

Compress.pattern: Static method taking Presentation object — mutates in-place, must call pres.Save() after
Compress.critical: FORBIDDEN: Compress without pres.Save() — output is NOT automatic

Merger.pattern: Static file-path array — simplest overload, requires 2+ input PPTX files

allowed_types_configured.required_action: Set status=active AND allowed_types=[Compress, Convert, Merger] in slides.yml upon human pilot approval

target_repo_provisioned.evidence: slides.yml comment: 'NOTE: dedicated repo placeholder — does not yet exist. Will be provisioned by maintainer if/when discovery confirms LowCode namespace.'
target_repo_provisioned.required_action: Maintainer must create repo aspose-slides-net/Aspose.Slides.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples before live PR can be created

human_pilot_approval.required_action: Human must approve Slides pilot launch before generation run is authorized

approve_live_pr.required_action: APPROVE_LIVE_PR env must be set before any PR creation

what_is_already_done: slides.json denominator file created (3 workflow roots: Compress, Convert, Merger; 2 utility helpers)
slides.yml per_type_constraints for all 3 workflow roots: Convert + Compress + Merger
slides-pilot-readiness-design.json: full design with per-type API architecture
what_blocks_activation: BLOCKER 2: Human pilot approval not granted (status must change from discovery_only to active)
BLOCKER 3: GPT_OSS_MODEL not set in environment (generation blocked without LLM)

recommended_first_pilot_path.rationale: Convert.ToPdf is the simplest: static file-path call, no in-memory object required, output is a PDF (magic byte validation). No pair fixture needed. Lowest risk for first generation.
recommended_first_pilot_path.merger_note: Merger requires pair fixture (2 PPTX inputs) — same pattern as Words Merger (already proven successful)

activation_steps_when_approved: 2. Human approves: slides.yml status=active, allowed_types=[Compress, Convert, Merger]
4. Review Convert example: Convert.ToPdf(presPath, outPath), output has %PDF magic bytes
5. Review Compress example: load Presentation, call Compress.RemoveUnused*, call pres.Save()
6. Review Merger example: create 2 PPTX inputs, Merger.Process(inputArray, outputPath)
7. Set APPROVE_LIVE_PR and create PR to provisioned repo
known_risks: LOW: XML docs absence — LLM prompts lack docstring context but method signatures from reflection are sufficient
MEDIUM: Compress in-place mutation misuse — LLM may forget pres.Save() after Compress call; FORBIDDEN constraint addresses this
LOW: Unlicensed Aspose.Slides may add evaluation watermark to outputs — use file existence + size checks, not content equality
LOW: Merger pair fixture — same pattern as Words Merger (proven in Sprint 3); constraints and merger_input_creation_lines already defined
